---
title: "ESS and WID Descriptive Analysis"
format: html
---

This report compares country-year summaries of satisfaction with the state of
the economy (ESS `stfeco`) with distributional series from the World Inequality
Database (WID). Only years available in ESS and in both WID concepts are plotted
for a country.

```{r}
#| label: setup-analysis
#| include: false
source("R/load_project.R")
matching <- run_country_year_matching()
data_coverage <- run_data_coverage(matching)
country_timeseries <- run_country_timeseries(matching)
wid_distribution_change <- run_wid_distribution_change(matching)
ess_summary_change <- run_ess_summary_change()
```
